status: NEGATIVE — UI responsiveness restored, Pi delivery/stability failed
scope: Physical Digitakt OS 1.54 V01P diagnostic (worker priority 5) + Pi 4B 128-frame kernel, USB1 track 1, Pi voice muted

candidate.label: V01P
candidate.change: USB worker priority 14 -> 5; self-wake and protocol unchanged
candidate.emulator_checks: UI, native runtime and dense compiled exchange pass

human_trials.observation: Responsive while setting, saving and playing
Super responsive while setting, saving and playing; no UI stall reproduced

pi_measurement.interpretation: Lower worker priority restored UI responsiveness but the worker no longer services the control/playout path promptly. FIFO underruns and late parameter faults grow without the voice being armed. This variant is rejected.

evidence_classes.physical_measurement: V01 DIAG counters, Pi FIFO, playout faults and retained fault
evidence_classes.human_observation: Settings, Save and Play responsiveness at 32/32 and 64/64
evidence_classes.hypothesis: Priority inversion/insufficient worker service is the tradeoff; exact native scheduling path remains unproven

limitations: The human UI readings are approximate and not calibrated.
The worker priority change affects delivery as well as preemption; this test does not separate them.
The no-self-wake V01N variant was prepared in the emulator but not physically tested.
The Pi FIFO counter is cumulative per boot; readings are reported as observed and not normalized across restarts.
next_action: Restore I04R. Do not adopt priority 5. Continue with V01N/no-self-wake isolation or another bounded service design, then re-qualify delivery before UI responsiveness.
